This is a good benchmark task because: (1) it is observable and verifiable — the agent must look at or stand near the iron trapdoor, (2) it doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just visual recognition and navigation, (3) the scene can be designed with interesting navigation challenges to make the task non-trivial, and (4) completion can be clearly measured by checking if the iron trapdoor appears in the agent's field of view or if the agent is within a certain distance of it. Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, the dependency graph is a single node with no edges.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the iron trapdoor and face it, demonstrating they have visually located it. The iron trapdoor is placed at spawn-relative [4, 0, 1]. max_distance=3.0 ensures the player must walk at least ~1.1 blocks from spawn (since spawn-to-target distance is ~4.12 blocks). facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking toward the trapdoor.

scene_description: A small outdoor area with multiple structures: a stone brick building, an oak planks shed, a cobblestone wall, and a lantern. An iron trapdoor is placed on the ground in the open state at ~4 ~0 ~1, requiring the player to walk a few blocks east to find it. The open iron trapdoor appears as a distinctive thin panel/outline against the grass, making it visually recognizable but requiring navigation to reach.
task_text: Find the iron trapdoor in the area. Explore the structures and locate the iron trapdoor on the ground.
design_notes: The iron trapdoor is placed at ~4 ~0 ~1 (4 blocks east, 1 block south of spawn) on the ground in the open position. The open state makes it visually distinct as a thin upright/outlined panel on grass. The stone brick building (at ~6-10, ~0-3, ~4-8) serves as a landmark. The oak planks shed and cobblestone wall are distractor structures. The scene is compact (~20 block radius) and fully navigable. Validated 3 times via preview_scene_in_sandbox — agent consistently finds the trapdoor within 4-5 steps.
